changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE projects CHANGE COLUMN default_scope_id default_scope_id_rbac BIGINT;

changeSet.author: [Z4999972] Aditya Murda Nugraha
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN default_scope_id_abac BIGINT;

changeSet.author: [Z4999972] Aditya Murda Nugraha
changeSet.sql: UPDATE projects p SET p.default_scope_id_abac = ( SELECT s.scope_id FROM scopes s WHERE s.project_id = p.project_id AND s.access_control_model = 'ABAC' AND s.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.is_deleted = 0;
